source.rationale: miss-company-routing rev-3, single-company half + the nameCompany regex fix (2026-08-25). Reasoned before running: a single-company offer names the company inside the escalate phrase - `escalate to *Sorento* purchasing certification team?` - and exports cs_offer_company for compile-current-state's Delta4 arm. The team here is deliberately MULTI-WORD: since the team display prettifier landed, every multi-word team renders with spaces, and the clone's `\S+ team\?` regex cannot cross a space, so on the clone the company label silently vanished on every multi-word team. The widened class `(?:[a-z0-9-]+ )*[a-z0-9-]+ team\?` (byte-identical to the one compile-current-state ships at its own rewrite) is what makes this expected text reachable; this fixture goes red if anyone reverts to the clone form. The frozen parser prefix `Would you like me to escalate` sits before the insertion, untouched.
